label: Volleyball at the 2020 Summer Olympics (Tokyo) - Men's tournament, 15th edition (played 2021)
source: BUILT from cited bytes under WO-VB-3 (PLAN-VB). Capture: Wikipedia edition-page wikitext (action=raw); per-row sources = official FIVB vis2009 Results PDFs (getdocument.asmx ids 256318088-256321011) + archived olympics.com statistics PDFs in provenance; format census 2 pools of 6 RR (30) + QF/SF/3P/F (8) = 38 == built count. TOKYO-2020 PLAYED 2021: postponed by COVID-19 (IOC/Tokyo-2020 joint statement 24 Mar 2020 cited in-page), all matches behind closed doors at Ariake Arena, Tokyo - single-venue edition, edition_year 2021 = year actually played. FIDELITY: per-team pool points recomputed from set tokens == standings spw/spl for ALL 12 TEAMS (dual official standings source in-page: archived olympics.com groups page + volleyballworld standings). Spine exact: SF participants == QF winners, F == SF winners, 3P == SF losers. ROC ADJUDICATION: Russian team competed as 'ROC' (Russian Olympic Committee, WADA-ban naming era) - stored as-printed 'ROC', a distinct canon string from 'Russia' (which stays reserved for RUS-flagged rows) - recorded in DATA-RULES-VB naming policy this commit. Champions FRANCE - FIRST gold and first Olympic volleyball medal ever, d. ROC 3-2 (15-12 fifth) after being 0-2 pool start; Argentina bronze 3-2 over Brazil (first medal since 1988); host Japan's first Olympic QF since 1992 preserved with home flags incl. the 3-2 pool epic vs Iran (29-31 third set). Monster set preserved: France d. Brazil 39-37 set 2 (76 points - ties ITA-CAN 39-37 as store #2). 24 Jul - 7 Aug 2021.
